implementation_status: Implemented; SPEC-003 remains In progress because AC-003-29 visual-reference acceptance is unresolved.
source_layout: src/cli/manager-command.ts: lazy command registration and stdin/stdout TTY guard
src/manager/controller.ts: serialized foreground actions, status and transient UI state
src/manager/refresh-coordinator.ts: one abortable read, generation invalidation, bounded timeout, completion-driven polling
src/manager/services.ts: adapters to canonical C2C status, health, lifecycle, pairing, and connector-confirmation services
src/manager/index.tsx: Ink render and shared q/Ctrl+C/SIGTERM cleanup
src/manager/ui/: overview, health, workspace, activity, actions menu, and keyboard input panels

behavior.lazy_load: The root CLI imports only the small command registration module. That module checks stdin and stdout TTY status before dynamically importing the Manager entry.
behavior.action_policy: One available-action table backs both keyboard shortcuts and the menu. Start/Restart/Recover follow stopped/running/unknown broker state; Stop and Confirm require explicit confirmation; Fix requires a structured repairable issue. Pair uses current broker/tunnel state plus a healthy endpoint, and unavailable actions are hidden during a foreground action.

refresh.action_start: Immediately increments the read generation and aborts an active read without waiting for it.
refresh.completion: Keeps the foreground guard until the obsolete read retires, then performs one fresh read. Stale and late results cannot commit.

behavior.pairing: Pair requires a healthy endpoint and running broker/tunnel for initial authorization; a pending connector instruction also enables Pair while authorized. The new code remains in transient Manager state and does not clear the instruction.
behavior.confirmation: Confirm first requires explicit y/Enter confirmation, then passes the displayed MCP URL to the canonical confirmation service. A changed endpoint is rejected and the refreshed instruction remains visible.

layout.wide: Workspaces left; Health and Activity right.

exit.ctrl_c: PTY exit status 0 through the same close path; terminal restored.
exit.sigterm: Manager unmounted and terminal restored in about 1.5 seconds; process returned standard signal status 143.

visual_reference.evidence: The exact approved file was not present in current docs or recoverable from current git history/object listings. No replacement was fabricated and the user-provided SPEC was not changed.

108 passed across 10 suites with scoped elevated loopback/flock access.

dist/manager contains compiled JavaScript and source maps for the Manager modules and UI.

validation.environment: Disposable HOME and C2C_HOME under /tmp; package-copy contract reproduced because c2c install writes hard-coded /usr/local/bin symlinks.
validation.result: 136 packages reused, 0 downloaded; Ink 6.8.0 and React 19.3.0 present in the production tree. The install was repeated after the Manager policy fixes with the exact cached pnpm CLI.

Final frozen production package-copy launched through the actual bin/c2c.js entry; c2c --help lists manager and c2c --profile p1-smoke manager rejects non-TTY with the clear guard. System script PTYs at 80-column narrow and 120-column wide rendered Workspaces and Health; q exited 0. Earlier post-build production PTY validation also confirmed Ctrl+C exit 0 and SIGTERM terminal restoration within the bounded exit window (process returned standard status 143).

The first tracked check identified mixed CRLF endings in tsconfig.json; after normalizing that touched file, tracked git diff --check and git diff --no-index --check on 21 P1 untracked source, test, and ledger files produced no whitespace diagnostics.

environment.disk_space: No capacity blocker; preflight reported 16 GB available and the frozen install reused the existing package store.
environment.sandbox_retry: The default sandbox P0 run failed local binds with EPERM and runtime flock calls with ETIMEDOUT (38 failed, 51 passed, 19 skipped); the same command passed 108/108 under scoped elevated permission. Occurrence recorded in the existing codex-friction loopback-test issue.
